about: Modwerk source-only Mute Latch package for Digitakt II OS 1.17, compiled from sdk/digitakt-ii/modules/mute-latch with the pinned toolchain.

mods.title: Mute Latch
mods.summary: Press PERFORM while choosing tracks in PREP MUTES and the mutes wait for the end of the pattern, for up to four passes.
mods.description: Press PERFORM while choosing tracks in PREP MUTES and the mutes wait for the end of the pattern, for up to four passes.
mods.author: crisp909
mods.on_unit: The author reported the switch timing of this source working on a Digitakt II on OS 1.17 with a build from a different compiler (GCC 13); this exact package, built with GCC 16.2.0, has not yet run on a unit.
